a1.text: A naturalist suggests barnacles and drifting plants inspired it.

a2.text: The sailor insists the trees were real, and no one can verify the claim.

b1.text: The tapestry delights children and visitors.

b2.text: The design becomes mistaken for an eyewitness record.

c1.text: The story survives without being declared fact.
